card.name: Middle of split-up longer words
card.fires_on: Fires on a short piece partway through a longer word that the text splits up, such as the 'SC' in ADOLESCENTS or 'as' in Extravasation. It is seen in medical terms and in some other rare words.

modes.label: Medical words
modes.description: A middle piece inside a long clinical word such as extravasation or adolescents.

modes.label: Other rare words
modes.description: A middle piece of a name or unusual word in general web text.
